profile.headline: Infrastructure Software Engineer/Web Programmer (Full Stack)
profile.summary:
I have a passion for creation. It is one of the greatest gifts of being human. For both work and play I push my skills in order to become a better creator. 

Additionally, I help others hone skills that I have acquired (WTA instructor). 

I also make a mean carne asada! (If you don't believe me, I will prove it to you.)

positions.title: Full Stack Web Programmer, Brigham Young University
positions.description:
Developed web software for Independent Study, Risk Management, Center for Teaching and Learning, and currently for BYU Studies. 

My projects that I contributed to are extensive, but some of the following are

- BYU Learning Management System (Learning Suite)
- Independent Course Software
- CK Editor Integration
- Designed entire system for Risk Management (BYU chemical safety and inventory)

I have worked in depth in both CSS styling, Javascript (jQuery, Vanilla, BackboneJS, Require.JS, Underscore.JS, EXT.js ), PHP (Zend Framework), and MySQL database systems. I have also used some CMS (Drupal) with legacy code.

positions.title: PHP/MEAN Stack Instructor
positions.description:
Created Spanish curriculum for Mexican and Chilean students for start up World Tech Academy. (http://www.worldtechacademy.com)

I integrated the current English curriculum and made it applicable to Spanish speakers.
